title: WPA Institute Index / Protocolometry — Four-Pillar Operating Model
principle: The global corpus tests the methodology; the methodology must not erase the diversity of the corpus.
institutional_dna_reuse_principle: Verified institutional practices extracted under Pillar 2 are not confined to ranking. After provenance and human review, they may inform research, programmes, simulations, publications, practitioner learning, strategy, governance, AI-assisted knowledge systems and future institutional development across WPA.

pillars.name: Global Coverage Expansion
pillars.objective: Build the most defensible global corpus of diplomatic academies, foreign-service institutes, protocol schools and closely related institutions without treating 160 as a ceiling.

pillars.name: Institutional Core Extraction Engine
pillars.objective: Extract the documented institutional DNA of each resolved institution from public, lawful and attributable evidence and convert approved insights into source-traceable Institutional Practice Atoms for governed reuse across WPA.

pillars.name: Methodology Validation
pillars.objective: Use extracted practices to test whether I01-I20 are complete, non-duplicative, fair across peer types and stable under reasonable weighting choices; distinguish methodology lessons from broader institutional-learning lessons.
controls: no weight tuning for preferred winners
high correlation is a review trigger

pillars.name: Human Governance and Publication Gate
pillars.objective: Keep institutional authority, dispute resolution, consequential publication and material reuse under accountable human control.
outputs: separate public-ranking decision if ever authorised
controls: AAB review only after formal constitution
public ordinal ranking disabled until separate decision

institutional_dna_reuse_domains: Simulations, Case Studies and Scenario Labs
coverage_completion_rule: Global Coverage Pass v1 is complete as a reproducible first-pass search and verification milestone across the five target regions. It is not a claim that no additional institution can later be discovered, corrected or added.
dossier_factory_rule: Agents create source-bounded dossiers one by one from the controlled queue. Dossier completion never creates an authoritative score; human review and later methodology-validation gates remain mandatory.
reuse_rule: Approved institutional DNA must be made available for governed reuse across eligible WPA Institute domains through Practice Atoms. Reuse preserves provenance, limitations and human authority and may not silently modify doctrine, policy or consequential institutional outputs.
